observations.behavior: Natural-spawn support selection and rider movement are invariant under reverse player array order in this tested input sequence. One-tick carrier-left counterfactuals at the previously failing ticks also match.

Synchronized walking and repeated held jumps do not solve the first stair or reach the key within 20 simulated seconds for any population. The team needs coordinated support/switch/spring actions; no fairness or fun conclusion follows from this stress script.

Goal queue is tested only after fixture-opening the goal. Warp and tower tests place players on original terrain. Neither proves that all eight players can complete the original route. Native timing, source contact fidelity, and human coordination remain unverified.

summary.scope: 2..8 population simulation, actual spawn-input stress, and explicitly placed original-terrain mechanic fixtures. No complete key-to-goal route or human fun assessment.
